summary: An audit readiness marker existed even though the audit produced zero qualifying playback checks, making the machine state too easy to misread as an audit pass.
evidence: S-AUDIT-PILOT-L007 completion explicitly states playback_verified=0 for both segments and 0 real playback checks toward Pilot-60.
The previous readiness marker encoded only stage=audit plus free-text validation and had no machine-readable pass/count fields.
safe_workaround: Pilot-60 accounting must count only explicit qualifying real playback checks, never the existence of an audit readiness marker.
resolution_notes: The existing L007 marker now explicitly records audit_outcome=blocked_no_playback, qualifying_playback_checks=0, counts_toward_pilot_60=false and timing_accuracy_measured=false. Future audit accounting must use explicit evidence/counts rather than marker existence.
